::: {.why}
Almost every estimator in the next five weeks assumes it, almost no price series has it, and the gap between those two facts is where spurious results come from.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- State weak stationarity in three conditions, and say which of the three a price series violates and which a return series might.
- Name one financial series that is plausibly stationary, one that is clearly not, and one that is arguable, and defend the third.
